title: Vue Essentials
description: Vue's official packages: the core framework, router, state store, and test utilities — and how the Composition API fits together.

data.text: Vue is deliberately modular: `vue` is the only mandatory package, and routing, state, and tooling are separate official packages you add when you need them.

data.title: Scaffold a Vue 3 app and add the classics
data.code:
npm create vue@latest my-app   # prompts for TypeScript, Router, Pinia
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev

data.caption: src/components/Counter.vue — script setup + Composition API
data.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';

const count = ref(0);
const doubled = computed(() => count.value * 2);

function increment() {
  count.value += 1;
}
</script>

<template>
  <button @click="increment">count is {{ count }} (doubled {{ doubled }})</button>
</template>

data.text: `<script setup>` is the recommended authoring style in Vue 3: top-level bindings are exposed to the template automatically, and `ref`/`reactive` provide reactivity. The Options API still works and is common in older codebases, so expect to read both in interviews.

data.title: Vue 2 is end-of-life
data.text: Vue 2 stopped receiving updates on 31 December 2023, and the old `vue-router@3` / `vuex@3` line is unsupported. New projects should use Vue 3 with `vue-router@4` and Pinia (Vuex is in maintenance mode).

terms.definition: Vue 3's function-based API (setup, ref, computed) for organising component logic.
A reactive wrapper around a value, accessed through .value in script.
Vue's official store; replaces Vuex with a simpler, TypeScript-friendly API.
Single-File Component — a .vue file containing template, script, and style blocks.

data.title: What interviewers look for
data.text: Be able to contrast the Options API with the Composition API, and explain why Pinia replaced Vuex. Mention that reactivity is tracked automatically in Vue rather than through immutable updates like React.

data.title: Key takeaways
points: vue is the only required package; router, store, and tests are separate.
Composition API with <script setup> is the modern default.
Pinia is the official Vue 3 store; Vuex is legacy.
vue-tsc type-checks .vue files where tsc cannot.
data.takeaway: Vue's modularity is the point: you add a package only when the app needs the capability.
